newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 17 - Thursday, June 26.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, June 17 - Thursday, June 26.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JUNE 17

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-65/95, C-111/95 Shingara: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 9 of Council directive 64/221/EEC of February 25, 1994, on the coordination of special measures concerning the movement and residence of foreign nationals which are justified on grounds of public policy, public security or public health. French citizen denied entry into the United Kingdom for reasons of public security. - Judgment C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 52, 58 and 59. National legislation on the operation of old people's homes. Social services reserved for non profit bodies. Public funding of services. - Oral procedure C-321/95 Greenpeace Council v/ Commission: regional policy. Appeal against ordinance delivered August 9, 1995, in case T-585/93, Greenpeace Council v/ Commission. Action rejected as inadmissible. Legal or natural persons. Act addressed to a member state and affecting the non economic interests of the claimants. Environmental implications of the construction of two power stations in the Canary islands.

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-105/96 Codiesel: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of positions 84.53, 85.01 B II and 85.04 B I of the Common Customs and Excise Tariff in effect in 1986. Electrical appliance. "Uninterrupted Power Supply" (UPS)

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-164/95 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 316/91 of February 7, 1991, on the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature. Positions NC 0406 2090 (grated and powdered cheese of all types) and NC 0406 9011 (cheeses other than fresh, grated, powdered, melted, or veined, intended for processing). Grated cheese, compressed and packaged, with oxygen substitution by nitrogen injection, presented as a compact and pasty mass that breaks up into irregular granules after unpackaging and exposure to room conditions.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-360/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/371/EEC of June 20, 1991, on the application of the accords between the EC and the Swiss confederation on direct insurance other than life insurance. - Opinion C-361/95 Commission v/ Spain: free movement of persons. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/49/EEC of June 18, 1992 co-ordinating on laws, regulations and administrative provisions on direct insurance other than life insurance and amending directives 73/239/EEC and 88/357/EEC. - Opinion C-27/96 Danisco Sugar: membership of new states. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 137, paragraph 2, 145, paragraph 2 and 149, paragraph 1 of the 1994 Membership act, of EC treaty articles 39 and 40 and of Commission regulation 3300/94 of December 21, 1994, halting temporary measures in the sugar sector following the membership of Austria, Finland and Sweden. National contribution on stocked sugar introduced following the membership of Sweden and affecting sugar stocked in Sweden at the time. - Opinion joined cases C-31/96, C-32/96, C-33/96 Naranjo Arjona: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 47, paragraph l(e) and (g) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 1248/92 of April 30, 1992. Calculation of the theoretical amount of the old age pension by the institution of a member state whose law determines that the calculation be based on mean contributions.
THURSDAY, JUNE 19

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-184/95 Dorsch Consult v/ Council and Commission: external relations. Appeal for compensation for damages supposedly sustained by the claimant following the adoption by the council of regulation 2340/90 of August 8, 1990, preventing community trade with Iraq and Kuwait, without making provisions to compensate victims sustaining economic reprisals on the part of the Iraqi authorities.

SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-260/94 Air Inter v/ Commission: transport. Annulment of article 1 of Commission decision 94/291 of April 27, 1994, on an application procedure for Council regulation 2408/92. (Case VII/AMA/IV/93 - TAT - Paris (orly) - Marseille, and Paris (orly) - Toulouse)(Case C-301/94 discharged by the court after France's withdrawal from the case.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, JUNE 24-26.
TUESDAY, JUNE 24

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. - Opinion C-317/95 Canadane Cheese Trading: free movement of goods. - Opinion joined cases C-364/95, C-365/95 T. Port: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-213/96 Outokumpu: free movement of goods. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-171/96 Pereira Roque: membership.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25
FOURTH CHAMBER (1030/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-237/96 Amelynck: free movement of goods.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-172/96 First National Bank of Chicago: taxation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-285/94 Italy v/ Commission: agriculture. - Judgment joined cases C-304/94, C-330/94, C-342/94, C-224/95 Tombesi: environment and consumers. - Judgment C-45/95 Commission v/ Italy: taxation. - Judgment C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods. - Judgment C-131/96 Mora Romero: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-132/96 Stinco: free movement of persons.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-7/96 Perillo v/ Commission: external relations. - Oral procedure T-331/94 IPK v/ Commission: social policy. - Oral procedure T-246/93 Buehring v/ Council and Commission: agriculture.
THURSDAY, JUNE 26
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-368/95 Familiapress Zeitungsverlag: free movement of goods. Opinion C-188/95 Fantask: taxation.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-143/96 Leonhard Knubben Speditions: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation. - Judgment C-329/96 Commission v/ Greece: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-375/95 Commission v/ Greece: taxation. - Opinion joined cases C-69/96, C-70/96, C-71/96, C-72/96, C-73/96, C-74/96, C-75/96, C-76/96, C-77/96, C-78/96, C-79/96 Garofalo: free movement of persons.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-280/95 Commission v/ Italy: state aid. - Opinion C-356/95 Witt: agriculture. - Opinion C-369/95 Somalfruit: agriculture. - Opinion C-42/96 Immobiliare SIF: taxation. - Opinion C-206/96 Commission v/ Luxembourg: environment and consumers.
